What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Sorry the tracking hasn’t updated — I know that’s frustrating. Here’s what to try:
Confirm your dispatch email and which courier it’s with (DPD or Royal Mail). Tracking links often only become active after the first scan.
Give it a little time: scans can lag, especially in the evenings, at weekends, or on bank holidays.
• DPD: You’ll usually see updates by the morning of delivery (with a 1‑hour slot). If there’s no movement 1 business day after dispatch, that’s unusual.
• Royal Mail: The first scan can take up to 24–48 hours after dispatch.
Check the courier’s app/website directly using the tracking number and refresh the page/app.

I’m sorry this has happened — I know how worrying that is. Here’s what to do next:
Check the tracking details for any delivery photo, safe‑place note, neighbour/collection point info, or a delivery card number.
Look around likely spots: safe places, porches, bins/recycling boxes, sheds/garages, meter cupboards, communal areas, concierge/reception, and with neighbours. Also check your letterbox and mailroom if applicable.
If it’s DPD: the app/site usually shows a delivery photo and map pin. If the photo/location doesn’t match, let me know — I can raise this with them.
If it’s Royal Mail: they may leave it in a designated safe place or with a neighbour and pop a card through the door. Sometimes the scan appears before the item reaches your door, so give it a little time.
Confirm the delivery address in your order confirmation just in case there’s a typo.
If you still can’t locate it, I can investigate with the courier and arrange a replacement or refund if needed. Please share:
The tracking link (or which courier it is)
A quick note confirming you’ve checked safe places/neighbours
Once I have those, I’ll get on it right away and keep you posted.

turns.replyText:
Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Short answer: usually no — once an order has dispatched, we can’t change it to a completely different address for security reasons. But there are a couple of options depending on the courier:
DPD: In the DPD app or the tracking link, you can often:
• Divert to a DPD Pickup shop
• Leave with a neighbour or in a safe place
• Change the delivery date/time
(Changing to a brand‑new address isn’t supported.)
Royal Mail: Address changes aren’t possible after dispatch, but you can usually:
• Collect from your local Delivery Office with ID
• Arrange redelivery to the same address
• Set a neighbour or safe‑place preference
If your order hasn’t dispatched yet, we may be able to help by updating details or cancelling so you can reorder to the correct address. If you’d like me to check what’s possible for your order, please share your order number and delivery postcode, and I’ll take a look right away.

Do you compensate for a long delay?
I’m really sorry you’ve had a long delay. We always want your order to arrive on time, and if it doesn’t, we’ll make it right.
What we can do typically includes:
Arrange a free replacement to arrive on the next available date, or
Offer a refund, and in some cases a credit, depending on what happened and whether an occasion was missed or the item arrived late/affected.
If you’d like me to review your case now, please share:
A quick summary of the delay (promised date vs. actual/expected date) and any tracking link
Once I have those, I’ll check the tracking, confirm what went wrong, and sort the best resolution right away.
